description: Stash the current state without changing anything, so it can be restored from the history sidebar. Do this before editing a .excalidraw file directly with your own file tools - every other tool here snapshots on its own.

label.description: Short description of what this change is doing, e.g. 'add the dog illustration'. Shown next to the snapshot in the history sidebar, which is how the user decides whether to keep or revert it. Always set it.

scene.description: Scene id, exact name, or a unique part of the name. Use list_scenes if unsure.

name: snapshot_scene
